title: Complete realization of multifractal entropy spectra and pressure functions
summary: We give a complete characterization of the multifractal entropy spectra arising from continuous vector-valued potentials on transitive two-sided shifts of finite type. We prove that, in every finite dimension, any nonnegative upper semicontinuous concave function on a compact convex set that attains the topological entropy as its maximum at a unique point is realized as the entropy spectrum of a potential whose rotation set is precisely that set.
